incidents.title: A repaired failed criterion remained failed instead of becoming affected for full-chain reverification
incidents.rootCause: Verification invalidation only selected passed and manual statuses, excluding the failed criterion that triggered repair
incidents.invariant: After a repair, every non-deferred acceptance result must become affected before reverification

incidents.title: A copied Skill CLI could exit silently when macOS exposed the same temporary path through /var and /private/var aliases
incidents.rootCause: Direct execution detection compared unresolved URL strings instead of canonical filesystem paths
incidents.invariant: CLI self-execution detection must compare canonical real filesystem paths

incidents.title: CLI check options --scope, --source-fingerprint, and --duration-ms are ignored and persisted as broad/unspecified
incidents.rootCause: The CLI wiring patch forwarded scoped-check options from the acceptance-record branch instead of the check branch, so recordCheck received no scope, fingerprint, or duration
incidents.invariant: Every CLI option that changes persisted verification semantics must be forwarded by its owning command and covered by a real-process regression test

incidents.title: Acceptance summary renders project-level evidence links relative to the task directory, so observations.json opens a missing path
incidents.rootCause: The report summary reused project-root evidence paths directly even though report.md is nested under the task directory; the handoff renderer used a correct task-relative helper but resultTable did not
incidents.invariant: Every local link emitted into a task report must be computed relative to the report directory and validated to remain inside the project root
tests: detailed handoff renders project-level observations evidence as ../../environments/observations.json

incidents.title: Legacy projects without .openatdd/reverification/index.json fail during deferred historical finalization instead of initializing an empty cache index.
incidents.rootCause: The finalizer assumed the v0.3 reverification cache index had already been created, but resumed legacy repositories can predate that runtime artifact.
incidents.invariant: Historical finalization treats an absent runtime cache as an empty cache; cache presence is never a prerequisite for delivery.
tests: affected history initializes a missing reverification index and recreates it atomically

incidents.title: Chinese conversations still receive English template and UAT report labels even though no language option should be required.
incidents.rootCause: Human-facing templates, contract aliases, and report rendering were hard-coded to English instead of deriving display language from the current requirement and solution artifacts.
incidents.invariant: Human-facing artifacts follow the conversation language carried by requirement and solution content without a language flag, configuration, or selection prompt.
tests: human-facing templates and reports infer Chinese without a language option

incidents.title: Formal finalization marks ASSISTED criteria passed before the required human judgment and evidence boundary is complete.
incidents.rootCause: Finalization collapsed prepared evidence and required human judgment into one passed status for every criterion classification.
incidents.invariant: Only AUTO acceptance can be finalized as passed; ASSISTED and MANUAL always remain explicit human judgments.
tests: formal finalization keeps ASSISTED and MANUAL criteria manual and rejects ASSISTED self-pass

incidents.title: The solution summary order and review gate do not deterministically enforce risks, exclusions, consistency, or independent reviewer evidence.
incidents.rootCause: The solution contract checked named sections but not their progressive order, and a free-form review lacked complete checks and independent reviewer provenance.
incidents.invariant: A solution can pass review only when its complete human summary precedes details and every required review check is bound to the current hash and reviewer evidence.
tests: and independent scoped-review dispatch are enforced

incidents.title: Resumed repairs and dispatched fresh-context agents are not automatically supplied the scoped implementation or verification context.
incidents.rootCause: Resume, repair, and Agent dispatch recorded control state but did not invoke one shared scoped-context loader for the appropriate surface.
incidents.invariant: Every resumed delivery action and fresh-context Agent receives the current source-hashed implementation or verification view before work continues.
tests: and Agent dispatch restore and record source-hashed scoped context

incidents.title: The semantic graph does not ingest project standards or research and does not derive shared-invariant task impacts automatically.
incidents.rootCause: Graph discovery omitted standards and research directories, while invariants were keyed by incident identity instead of canonical content.
incidents.invariant: Relevant standards, research, and canonical invariant relationships remain source-hashed, rebuildable inputs to context and impact analysis.
tests: standards and research enter scoped graph context and shared invariant content derives task impacts without path overlap

incidents.title: The release finalization claims Agent evaluation coverage without a persisted report from an actual model and bare-agent comparison.
incidents.rootCause: Formal acceptance relied on mock evaluation tests because no bundled real-model adapter, persisted-report verifier, or pass-rate guard existed.
incidents.invariant: A formal real-Agent claim requires repeated hidden-check evidence from the bundled real-model adapter; mock or partial-pass reports never satisfy it.
tests: bundled Codex primary and bare adapters run twice and finalization verifies a 100-percent primary real-model report
